# Axiom Works AgentReader

> Pay-per-call tools for AI agents. No API keys: x402 (HTTP 402) + USDC on Base (eip155:8453), payTo 0x88b1c747c33A5868A34057D8C57318E5602b3ff6.
> Free truncated samples: https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/samples/{read|company|uk-company|uk-company-lite|convert|uk-charity|uk-charity-full|us-sec|us-sec-full|eu-vat|uk-leads|uk-leads-lite|kyb} (8/IP/day). Or add &preview=1 on paid GETs (same limit).

## When to use which (pick one)

| Need | Endpoint | Price | Why ours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page → Markdown | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/read?url= | $0.002 | Readability + metadata JSON, not raw HTML |
| Links only | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/links?url= | $0.001 | Cheaper than /read |
| Domain health | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/check?domain= | $0.001 | DNS/TLS/MX/SPF/DMARC + score |
| Website company research | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/company?domain= | $0.25 | Sourced tech/contacts/DNS/RDAP/news (no LLM fiction) |

## Free
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/samples/:kind — cached truncated real examples + upsell
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/monitor/:id — monitor status · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/hooks/sink — webhook test sink (POST)
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/llms.txt · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/openapi.json · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/.well-known/x402 · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/.well-known/agent.json · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/mcp · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/health

## Pay
HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2). Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (@x402/fetch, x402-axios, @axiomworks/agentreader). MCP: https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/mcp

## npm
- SDK: npm i @axiomworks/agentreader — createClient({ privateKey }) auto x402 + preview mode
- MCP stdio: npx -y @axiomworks/agentreader-mcp — Claude Desktop / Cursor / Claude Code (set AGENTREADER_PRIVATE_KEY)
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@axiomworks/agentreader · https://www.npmjs.com/package/@axiomworks/agentreader-mcp

## pip
- LangChain: pip install agentreader-tools — agentreader_tools(private_key=…)
- CrewAI: pip install agentreader-crewai — agentreader_crewai_tools(private_key=…)
- LlamaIndex: pip install llama-index-tools-agentreader — AgentReaderToolSpec(private_key=…).to_tool_list()
- PydanticAI / OpenAI Agents: pip install "agentreader-agents[all]"
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/agentreader-tools/ · https://pypi.org/project/agentreader-crewai/ · https://pypi.org/project/llama-index-tools-agentreader/ · https://pypi.org/project/agentreader-agents/
- Dashboard: https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/dashboard · Landing: https://grokbot1233.github.io/agentreader/

## Clients
x402 v2 (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; @x402/fetch, @x402/axios, Python x402>=2, @x402/mcp) and legacy v1 (402 JSON body + X-PAYMENT; x402-fetch, x402-axios, older AgentKit) both settle. Free ?preview=1 on GET routes.
